scope: legacy PQ accessory projection versus current canonical accessory reconciliation layer
findings: The legacy PQ accessory report remains internally consistent at 74 acc-### records and 32 forward/32 reverse PQ edges.
The current canonical accessory reconciliation layer has 116 accr-### identities after the 2026-09-24 raid identity batch.
The two layers use different stable ID namespaces and serve different purposes; the 74-record PQ projection is not a count of the complete current canonical accessory inventory.
No new PQ edge is inferred from the newer accr-### identities without explicit PQ provenance.
evidence_boundary: This audit corrects the interpretation of current counts across accessory layers. It does not infer PQ acquisition for accessories that only have raid, event, shop, gift, wish, or other non-PQ provenance.
